'''Rod Latham Mains And Toys LS''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Rod Latham]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls1.htm Mains And Toys], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010319184643/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls1.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
